description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering, managing, and resolving gateway services on a network, utilizing Bonjour (mDNS/DNS-SD) and other fallback discovery mechanisms. It includes data structures for representing gateways and their identities, resolution logic for network services, and background tasks for continuous discovery.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class managing network gateway discovery, resolution, and state management.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Holds resolved network service details including host, port, and TXT records.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Handles resolution of network services using NetService, with delegate callbacks.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate fallback gateway discovery over wide-area networks.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate fallback gateway discovery via Tailscale Serve.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery tasks and cleans up resources.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Maps wide-area discovery beacons into internal gateway representations.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Maps Tailscale Serve discovery beacons into internal gateway representations.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates internal gateway list based on network results.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Ensures resolution of a specific network service given its identifiers.
